responsibility: This file implements the AArch64 RTL pass that tracks potentially mis-speculated control flow and inserts mitigation code for speculation-safe value handling. It scans conditional branches, calls, returns, and speculation-barrier users, maintains a dedicated tracker register synchronized with SP across call boundaries, emits CSEL/CSETM- and SP-masking-based tracking sequences, and installs the pass entry point make_pass_track_speculation used when -mtrack-speculation is enabled.
